note: Bits per pixel a texture takes once imported, by compress mode and alpha, plus size limits per target. A project overrides limits in art/policy.json.
bits_per_pixel_source: Measured 2026-11-15 on Godot 4.7.2, Linux desktop (s3tc_bptc): .ctex payload of 256x256 PNGs imported headless. compress/mode 2 gave 8 bpp with alpha (BC3), 4 opaque (BC1), 8 with high_quality (BPTC); mode 3 gave 32 with alpha and 24 opaque on disk; raw_opaque is 32 from the GPU measure in raw_modes_note.
raw_modes_note: Measured 2026-11-15 on Godot 4.7.2, Linux, RTX 4090: RENDERING_INFO_TEXTURE_MEM_USED after loading 1024x1024 PNGs. Modes 0 (lossless) and 1 (lossy) took 4,194,304 bytes with or without alpha on Forward+ (Vulkan), so opaque raw is counted at 32 bpp; mode 2 took 1,048,576 with alpha and 524,288 opaque, as the .ctex payloads. The Compatibility renderer (OpenGL) reported 24 bpp opaque and 32 with alpha, each times 4/3. Basis (mode 4) is counted as vram, UNTESTED.
mipmap_factor_source: Measured 2026-11-15 on Godot 4.7.2: 87,460 / 65,588 bytes for the same 256x256 texture with and without mipmaps.
